descriptions.zh: 我们在[Planet.GetName]地表上的撞击坑的极深处探测到了异常的地震活动。地下声呐发现了一座前所未知的洞穴。
descriptions.en: We've detected anomalous seismic activity from deep inside an ancient crater on the surface of [Planet.GetName]. Underground sonar revealed a previously unknown cavity.
